bifrost: no screen saver module or SDK class. Idle display-off and auto-lock live in springboard/src/shell/mod.rs and springboard/wm/src/input.rs; app preferences in springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs
summary: Apple's framework is a plug-in interface: a .saver bundle subclasses ScreenSaverView, which the system animates in its own engine. BifrOSt has no such plug-in host, no SDK class for it, and no screen saver preview or configuration sheet. The idle display-off, auto-lock and suspend-after-screen-off behaviour that a screen saver sits on top of exists in the shell and system layer, but no app can hook into it.

features.note: no .saver bundle loader and no screen saver engine; the shell has no idle-animation host

gaps: No screen saver plug-in host: no .saver bundle loading and no ScreenSaverView lifecycle (start, animate, stop).
No SDK class for ScreenSaverView, ScreenSaverDefaults or the SSRandom and SSCenteredRect helpers.
No preview or configuration sheet for screen savers in Settings.
Idle state is not exposed to apps: an app cannot learn that the system went idle or start its own idle animation.
Sleep inhibitors are read by the system but no app API lets an app hold one.
